# Captured stdout of a real `codex review --uncommitted` run on the $0-local
# Ollama rig (codex-cli v0.142.3), proving the wd review plumbing end-to-end:
# verb -> Codex.ReviewCmd -> codex review run -> streamed output.
#
# How it was captured (no auth, no spend — BYO config selects the provider, same
# stance as the Codex launch path):
#   cd <a git worktree with uncommitted changes>
#   codex review --uncommitted \
#     -c model_provider=ollama -c model=qwen2.5-coder:7b
#
# The `ollama` provider is a codex built-in (reserved id) pointing at the local
# Ollama daemon; `codex review` has no `--oss` flag (that lives on `codex exec`),
# so the provider is selected via `-c model_provider=ollama`. The argv warden's
# Codex.ReviewCmd emits is just `codex review --uncommitted` — the model/provider
# is the operator's config, never forced by warden.
#
# Note on quality: qwen2.5-coder:7b reviewed a diff that planted a real bug (an
# `add()` that subtracts, plus a zero-division) and concluded "no bugs". That is
# the documented weak-tiny-model caveat (design §5): the pilot proves the
# plumbing, NOT review accuracy on a 3B/7B local model — quality rides the
# operator's real model. (qwen2.5-coder:3b failed to emit any structured review
# at all: "Reviewer failed to output a response.")
#
# Environment-noise lines elided: codex's periodic "ERROR codex_models_manager:
# failed to refresh available models" (Ollama's /v1/models payload shape) and the
# repeated streaming duplicates of the final line.
